plan: [ This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. A dominant strategy is to bid truthfully because your bid only determines whether you win; the price paid is the second-highest bid. Underbidding risks missing profitable wins; overbidding risks negative profit if the second-highest bid exceeds your value. Rational opponents also bid their values. To maximize expected profit this round, bid exactly my value: 26. ]

[ Single round, independent private values, second-price (Vickrey) auction with three bidders. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy: bidding my value maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ strategies. Overbidding risks winning when the second-highest bid exceeds my value (negative surplus). Underbidding risks losing when the second-highest bid is below my value (missed positive surplus). No history to leverage; no signaling benefits. Therefore, bid exactly my value: 18.0. ]

[ Independent private values and second-price rule imply truthful bidding is weakly dominant. Bidding my value ensures I win exactly when the second-highest bid is below my value and I pay that second price, maximizing expected profit. Shading below 21 risks losing profitable wins; bidding above 21 cannot increase payoff and only affects tie-breaks without gain. Single round, so no signaling or dynamic play. Therefore, bid my true value. ]
